authorization: User approved the saved decision_v4_draft.json plan in the current turn; execution date 2026-11-07
parameters_source: configs/experiment_v3.json and reports/experiment_v3/selections.csv; the current outer room was excluded from those choices
delta_target: PV(angle)-PV(0), paired within the same fitting room and HOY; fit angles 30,60,90 only; anchor delta(0)=0
delta_prediction: Predict signed deltas from X at nonzero angles; do not clip negative deltas; true PV(0) is never an inference input
absolute_prediction: Retain v3 nonnegative clipping; compute predicted gain as predicted PV(angle)-predicted PV(0)
selection: Largest mean inner-validation room net retained-hours PV gain over fixed 0; ties within 1e-12 kWh choose the larger threshold in declared order
decision: Enumerate four angles; choose lower angle on exact predicted-gain ties; switch only if maximum predicted gain strictly exceeds the selected threshold, else use 0
validation: Same seven outer leave-one-room-out and inner three GroupKFold splits as v3. Each inner fit uses four rooms and holds out two. No reuse of the seven-room outer OOF predictions for threshold calibration.
models_saved: 21 inner absolute models, 21 inner delta models, 7 outer delta models. Reuse the frozen v3 outer absolute XGBoost predictions and verify their source bundles.
primary_metrics: Room-level net retained-hours PV gain kWh over fixed 0
Mean/median/minimum room gain and improved/tied/worse counts
Retained-hours regret relative to four-angle simulation Oracle
secondary_metrics: Opportunity recall using pre-existing 0.0001 kWh v3 tolerance
Absolute PV MAE only where an absolute PV forecast exists
Selected-angle F300 and FUDI changes in percentage points
scope: Exploratory PV-only development pilot on seven previously examined rooms and retained Hour=7..18. No comfort optimization, new simulation, physical incidence feature, final TEST score or final seven-room deployment refit. Margins are empirical controls, not confidence bounds or actuator costs.
